title: Five Discourses on Not Penetrating Form, Etc.
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 33.21–25 Linked Discourses 33.21–25
  • 1. Vacchagottavagga 1. With Vacchagotta

Rūpaappaṭivedhādisuttapañcaka Five Discourses on Not Penetrating Form, Etc.

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. Ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo …pe…. At Sāvatthī.

“Rūpe kho, vaccha, appaṭivedhā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, appaṭivedhā …pe…. “Vaccha, it is because of not penetrating form …”

Pañcavīsatimaṁ.
